N5ESE.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
N5ESE.Unsupported: Naruto 5e — System Enhancements: Unsupported version pair. The API remains disabled.
N5ESE.Settings.Costs.Name: Dynamic Chakra Costs
N5ESE.Settings.Costs.Hint: Apply verified passive cost modifiers to native casting and concentration upkeep. Disabled by default; validate in a test world first.
N5ESE.ShockedCost: Shocked: the system increases the total cost to {cost} Chakra.
N5ESE.Unverified: Unverified feature, clan or damage assignment: no unconfirmed discount.
N5ESE.Choice.Hint: Choose which release or jutsu category this feature reduces. No selection means no corresponding discount.
N5ESE.MaintainBreakdown: Upkeep per round: base {base}, effective {final} Chakra. Only the strongest applicable reduction applies.
N5ESE.Choice.Title: Configure Chakra Choice
N5ESE.Choice.NoOptions: No eligible unassigned option is available. Master Weaver requires an owned concentration jutsu of C-Rank or lower.
N5ESE.Choice.Label: Release / Jutsu Category
N5ESE.Choice.Missing: A cost feature needs a selection. Open its sheet and use Configure Chakra Choice in the header menu.
N5ESE.Mode.Technical: Spend 1 Martial Die (d{die}); upkeep reduction is half its result, rounded up. Rolled only when casting.
N5ESE.Mode.Frenzy: Confirm casting as part of Chakra Frenzy activation: spend {dice} Martial Dice including Frenzy activation; upkeep 0. Frenzy benefits remain managed by its feature.
N5ESE.Mode.Busy: Finish the current casting workflow for this actor first.
N5ESE.Mode.Invalid: Casting mode is no longer eligible or resource consumption is disabled.
N5ESE.Mode.FrenzyUpkeep: Selected Force of Rage: effective upkeep is 0 Chakra; the ordinary upkeep shown above is waived.
N5ESE.Mode.TechnicalPending: Selected Technical Technique: the ordinary upkeep above is reduced after the casting roll, by half the Martial Die result rounded up. Only the strongest reduction applies.
N5ESE.Settings.Martial.Name: Refresh Martial pool at own turn start
N5ESE.Settings.Martial.Hint: Refreshes verified Martial Adept uses through native combat recovery. Existing recovery profiles retain control. No action economy automation; disabled by default.
N5ESE.Mode.MartialTechnique: Fixed Taijutsu base costs D 3 / C 5 / B 9 / A 14 / S 20; native upcast increases retained. Other casting reductions excluded; upkeep reductions remain available. Uncheck to use normal costs.
N5ESE.Mode.MartialTechniqueCost: Martial Technique: {cost} Chakra; other casting cost reductions excluded.
N5ESE.ExclusiveRankReduction: Only the strongest applicable rank-based cost reduction applies.
N5ESE.Choice.DamageHint: Choose the damage type of Medical Ninjutsu whose Chakra costs this feature reduces. No selection means no corresponding discount.
N5ESE.Settings.Dojutsu.Name: Dojutsu Controls
N5ESE.Settings.Dojutsu.Hint: Independent Dojutsu activation and Chakra sight on character sheets. Disabled by default; actions and individual abilities remain manual.
N5ESE.Dojutsu.Title: Dojutsu
N5ESE.Dojutsu.ManualActions: Action economy and individual Dojutsu abilities are managed manually. Duration follows Foundry world time.
N5ESE.Dojutsu.Level: The required character level has not been reached.
N5ESE.Dojutsu.External: An existing external effect is active. Manage that effect manually first.
N5ESE.Dojutsu.UnlockHint: Highest unlocked Tomoe stage. Required character level still applies.
N5ESE.Dojutsu.GMOnly: Only the GM can unlock Tomoe.
